title: Cookie Management & Tracking Prevention Request Letter Template
metaDescription: Free template to request websites stop tracking cookies. Protect your privacy with our simple letter format for cookie management and tracking prevention.
description: A professional letter template to request websites stop using tracking cookies and respect your privacy preferences. Includes all necessary legal language and customizable sections for effective cookie management communication.

sections.heading: Letter Header and Contact Information
sections.content:
[Your Name]
[Your Address]
[City, State, ZIP Code]

sections.heading: Subject Line and Introduction
sections.content:
Subject: Request for Cookie Management and Tracking Prevention

Dear [Company Name] Privacy Team,

I am writing to formally request that you stop placing tracking cookies on my device and cease all third-party tracking activities associated with my visits to your website. As a user concerned about my digital privacy, I am exercising my rights under applicable privacy laws to control how my personal data is collected and used.

sections.heading: Specific Cookie Management Requests
sections.content:
I specifically request the following actions:

1. Remove all tracking cookies currently stored on my device from your domain
2. Disable all third-party tracking cookies and pixels on pages I visit
3. Stop sharing my browsing data with advertising networks and data brokers
4. Implement a "Do Not Track" preference for my account/visits
5. Provide me with a simple way to manage cookie preferences going forward

I understand that essential cookies for website functionality may still be necessary, and I consent only to those required for basic site operation.

sections.heading: Legal Basis and Privacy Rights
sections.content:
This request is made under my rights provided by:

• The California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA)
• The General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) if applicable
• Your website's stated privacy policy and cookie management options
• My fundamental right to digital privacy

I do not consent to the processing of my personal data for marketing, advertising, or profiling purposes through cookies or similar tracking technologies.

sections.heading: Account Information (If Applicable)
sections.content:
If I have an account with your service, please apply these preferences to:

Account Email: [Your Account Email]
Account Username: [Your Username]
User ID: [If Known]

Please update my account settings to reflect my cookie and tracking preferences permanently.

sections.heading: Response Timeline and Confirmation
sections.content:
Please confirm receipt of this request within 5 business days and implement the requested changes within 30 days as required by applicable privacy laws.

I would appreciate written confirmation that:
• My tracking preferences have been updated
• Existing cookies have been flagged for removal
• Third-party tracking has been disabled for my visits
• My data will not be shared with advertising partners going forward

sections.heading: Closing and Signature
sections.content:
Thank you for respecting my privacy choices. I look forward to continuing to use your website with these privacy protections in place. For enhanced privacy protection, I also Use a privacy-focused browser to prevent tracking across all websites I visit.

If you have any questions about this request, please contact me at [Your Email].

Sincerely,

[Your Signature]
[Your Printed Name]
[Date]
